description: This file contains a static class 'PsMsgs' which provides a collection of message strings and message-generating functions used throughout the PDFsharp library. These messages are used for exceptions, validation, and informational purposes related to PDF processing.

classes.name: PsMsgs
classes.description: A static class providing predefined message strings and functions for generating messages related to PDF processing and graphics operations.

methods.name: ListEnumCurrentOutOfRange
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that an enumeration is out of range.

methods.name: PageIndexOutOfRange
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a page index is out of range.

methods.name: OutlineIndexOutOfRange
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that an outline index is out of range.

methods.name: SetValueMustNotBeNull
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a set value property must not be null.

methods.name: InvalidValue
methods.description: Generates a message indicating that a value is invalid within specified bounds.

methods.name: ObsoleteFunctionCalled
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that an obsolete function was called.

methods.name: OwningDocumentRequired
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a PDF object must belong to a document.

methods.name: FileNotFound
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a specified file does not exist.

methods.name: FontDataReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a message indicating font data is read-only.

methods.name: ErrorReadingFontData
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an error occurred while parsing font data.

methods.name: PointArrayEmpty
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a PointF array must not be empty.

methods.name: PointArrayAtLeast
methods.description: Generates a message indicating a PointF array must contain a minimum number of points.

methods.name: NeedPenOrBrush
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that either a pen or brush must be provided.

methods.name: CannotChangeImmutableObject
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that an immutable object cannot be changed.

methods.name: FontAlreadyAdded
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a font with the same name has already been added.

methods.name: NotImplementedForFontsRetrievedWithFontResolver
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a feature is not implemented for fonts retrieved with font resolver.

methods.name: InvalidPdf
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a stream is not a valid PDF.

methods.name: InvalidVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an invalid PDF version number.

methods.name: PasswordRequired
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a password is required.

methods.name: InvalidPassword
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an invalid password.

methods.name: OwnerPasswordRequired
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that an owner password is required for modification.

methods.name: UserOrOwnerPasswordRequired
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that either user or owner password is needed for encryption.

methods.name: CannotModify
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that the document cannot be modified.

methods.name: NameMustStartWithSlash
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a PDF name must start with a slash (/).

methods.name: ImportPageNumberOutOfRange
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a page import request has an out-of-range page number.

methods.name: StreamMustBeWritable
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a stream does not allow writing.

methods.name: MultiplePageInsert
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a page cannot be added because it is already owned by another document.

methods.name: UnexpectedTokenInPdfFile
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an unexpected token in a PDF file, suggesting possible corruption.

methods.name: InappropriateColorSpace
methods.description: Returns a message about a color space mismatch between document requirements and actual color definitions.

methods.name: CannotGetGlyphTypeface
methods.description: Returns a message indicating failure to retrieve a glyph typeface for a font.

methods.name: UnexpectedToken
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an unexpected token during PDF parsing.
